name: qs-design
description: A single routed product-design skill for iOS, Android, web, WeChat Mini Programs, and Alipay Mini Programs.

interface.shortDescription: 跨平台页面设计、可操作原型与交互验证
interface.longDescription: 从用户参考和已有实现中只提取功能、业务逻辑与契约，独立形成三套结构和视觉均不同的可操作原型供用户选择，再按 iOS、Android、Web、微信小程序和支付宝小程序的真实能力实现获批方向。
defaultPrompt: Use QS Design to extract only functions, business logic, and contracts from references, then produce three structurally and visually distinct isolated prototypes for selection before modifying product code.
Use QS Design to present three complete clickable directions, wait for the user to select one, then implement only the approved direction.
